whenToUse: A ⌘K palette for navigation, actions and record search across the app.
Keyboard-first pickers built on the list primitives.
avoidWhen: The main navigation — use Sidebar; ⌘K is a shortcut, not the only path.
Choosing a value inside a form — use Combobox.
a11y: The dialog has a label; results are a listbox with aria-activedescendant.
Every command is also reachable without the palette.
